result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. That is the same order the sales rep list uses.

The change is in `DataStorePart10.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart10.java`). I added the same priority `CASE` expression to its `ORDER BY` and updated the Javadoc. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded, as before.

I ran `RegionManagerTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest`, `RegionReportTest` and `TicketsPerSalesRepTest`, and they pass. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't covered by one.
